column4: Dashes in variable names, withdrawn in v2.2.0, were accepted again (closes docker/compose#12123, an unexpected character error for - since Compose v2.29.3)

column4: After a line using the inheritance syntax (a bare variable name taking its value from the environment), errors carried the wrong line number (resolves #649)
column12: 12ae694 counts the line of a bare name and 30e826e leaves the count alone when that name holds a space, so compose-go reports INVALID LINE as line 3 (#649; no test was added); in Bodu entries are KEY=value (docs/guides/formats/dotenv.md:7) and a line without = after its key is malformed input (docs/guides/formats/dotenv.md:74), so reading stops at the bare FOO on line 1

column4: Dashes in variable names were withdrawn because they conflict with the ${VAR-default} interpolation syntax (closes #663; accepted again in v2.3.0)
column12: aa1db26 reverted be170be: TestDash and the dashed key of TestParseBytes were removed, and - is again an unexpected character in a name; Bodu rejects it too, as keys match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* (Utf8DotEnvReader.cs:616, :624) and an invalid key name is malformed input (DotEnvFormatException.cs:15)

column4: A backslash-escaped quote inside a quoted value kept its backslash (closes docker/compose#11276; first shipped in v2.0.0-beta.2)
column12: compose-go reads the escaped quote inside single quotes, giving Let's go! (TestLoadQuotedEnv with the OPTION_K line added to fixtures/quoted.env, 81e1e90); Bodu's single quotes are literal (docs/guides/formats/dotenv.md:64, docs/docs/formats/parser-policies.md:36, Utf8DotEnvReader.cs:545), so the backslash is content and the second quote closes the value, and the text s go!' that follows it is malformed input, since only whitespace and a # comment may follow a closing quote (docs/guides/formats/dotenv.md:68, docs/docs/formats/parser-policies.md:39)
